text:
The mouse eradication on Gough Island first began in **2021**, and the year stands, but my earlier "late-2021" timing was wrong: the first island-wide aerial bait drop ran from June to August 2021, per the [ACAP news update](https://acap.aq/latest-news/the-first-bait-drop-on-gough-island-to-eradicate-its-house-mice-is-completed) and the [Wildlife Research paper](https://publish.csiro.au/WR/fulltext/WR22103). I also can't confirm my earlier claim that the campaign was declared successful, and I didn't find a final eradication outcome in that search.

CONFIDENCE: 85
